categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: investment holding, semiconductor packaging and testing (OSAT), electronic manufacturing services (EMS), and real estate development. The packaging and testing segment includes IC packaging, module design, multi-chip packaging, memory packaging, and testing services. EMS provides design, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, repair, and after-sales services for communication, consumer electronics, computer, storage, industrial, and automotive electronics. Real estate involves development, construction, sales, property management, and mall leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced semiconductor packaging such as 2.5D/3D system-in-package (SiP), fan-out wafer-level packaging (FOPLP), flip chip, bumping, optical packaging, and wafer-level chip scale packaging (WLCSP). The company develops proprietary plating, bonding, molding, and testing technologies, including AI-based visual inspection and automated test equipment. It also focuses on heterogeneous integration, silicon photonics, and power modules with advanced materials like SiC and GaN. Manufacturing processes involve wafer probing, IC assembly, SMT, and final testing with extensive automation and digital twin technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major international semiconductor companies, IDM manufacturers, and brand owners in sectors such as computing, communications, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial applications, and AI/high-performance computing. Key customers include leading global semiconductor firms and EMS clients. The end markets encompass PCs, smartphones, IoT devices, automotive systems, AI servers, and industrial electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are global, with major markets in the United States (60.25% of sales), Taiwan (14.99%), Europe (10.65%), and other Asian regions (14.11%). The company has manufacturing and R&D facilities in Taiwan, China, the US, Europe, Japan, Korea, Malaysia, and other locations, with strategic expansions in Japan and Malaysia to mitigate geopolitical risks and support regional supply chains.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on IC packaging, testing, and electronic manufacturing services. It sources wafers from upstream semiconductor foundries and supplies packaged and tested chips to IDM and fabless companies. It also produces substrates and materials for packaging and integrates components into modules and systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing heterogeneous integration and advanced packaging technologies (2.5D/3D SiP, fan-out WLP), silicon photonics, power modules, and AI chip packaging. The company invests 3-5% of revenue annually in R&D, focusing on miniaturization, system-level packaging, and green manufacturing. It emphasizes AI-driven process optimization, digital twin, and smart factory initiatives. Future R&D targets wireless communication modules (Wi-Fi 7, 5G mmWave), automotive electronics, AI computing platforms, and energy-efficient semiconductor solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of semiconductor packaging and testing services, electronic manufacturing services, and investment income. The company also earns from real estate development and leasing. Packaging and testing revenues come from contract manufacturing and service fees charged to semiconductor customers. EMS revenues derive from turnkey manufacturing and design services for electronic products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the global leader in semiconductor OSAT services, ranked number one worldwide by Gartner and Prismark. It competes with other major OSAT providers and EMS companies globally. The company maintains a competitive edge through advanced technology, extensive capacity, strong customer relationships, and integrated supply chain capabilities. It faces challenges from geopolitical tensions, rising competition, and technological innovation cycles.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of approximately NT$595 billion in the latest fiscal year, with steady growth driven by AI, 5G, and automotive electronics demand. It employs over 95,000 people with a stable workforce and invests heavily in capital expenditures and R&D. The company maintains a strong financial position with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades. It has issued corporate bonds totaling NT$20 billion with favorable credit ratings.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive, advanced semiconductor packaging and testing solutions with high reliability, quality, and technological leadership. Its differentiation lies in cutting-edge heterogeneous integration, miniaturization, and system-in-package capabilities tailored for AI, HPC, automotive, and 5G applications. It integrates vertically and horizontally across the supply chain to provide one-stop services, ensuring cost competitiveness and rapid time-to-market. The company also emphasizes sustainability, green manufacturing, and digital transformation to meet evolving customer and regulatory demands.
